package_scripts.qa:frontend: npm run audit:frontend && npm run smoke:pages
package_scripts.qa:handoff: npm run qa:frontend && npm run test:functionality
package_scripts.qa:visual: npm run qa:frontend && npm run screens:product
package_scripts.qa:visual:onboarding: npm run qa:frontend && npm run screens:product:onboarding && npm run visual:zip
package_scripts.shot:campaign:open: npm run shot:campaign && (xdg-open artifacts/screenshots 2>/dev/null || open artifacts/screenshots 2>/dev/null || true)
package_scripts.shot:homepage:open: npm run shot:homepage && (xdg-open artifacts/frontend-screenshots 2>/dev/null || open artifacts/frontend-screenshots 2>/dev/null || true)
package_scripts.visual:zip: rm -f futurefunded-visual-qa.zip && zip -r futurefunded-visual-qa.zip artifacts/frontend-screenshots && ls -lh futurefunded-visual-qa.zip
